next_row.strongest_rejected_alternative: Clustering with 25:9 (oshb:Prov.25.9) on the shared token רעך was rejected because that word recurs at 4 sites across this part (25:8, 25:9, 25:17, 27:10), too pervasive to bound a two-verse unit rather than mark a recurring relational theme.
